value.rationale: The exact sharp mean-square stability threshold solves a natural diagnostic problem for a published positivity-preserving stochastic heat integrator. It isolates a nontrivial gap between pathwise positivity, finite-horizon bounded moments, continuous-time mean-square stability, and indefinite repeated-step mean-square stability; a bona fide two-interior-node mass-lumped FE witness crosses from stable at h=1/9 to unstable at h=2/9 for the same physical coefficients. No general-mesh or global nonlinear SPDE theorem is claimed.
